_comment: Tools SlopNet can check for, install and run on your server. Shown in the Tools popup (Library to install, Installed to launch). 'check' is the command or private-account path looked for on the server; 'install' is run on the SERVER, in the console, so you can see exactly what happens; 'run' launches it in its own terminal tab when it has a safe standalone path. An empty 'install' means nobody has verified a safe install command yet, except antigravity which is preinstalled. An empty 'run' means SlopNet deliberately does not offer a standalone launch. Pinned binary installs download into a private directory, validate and run a staged candidate, then replace the old binary only after that proof. No install pipes network bytes into a shell. Add one and it appears in Tools; no rebuild is needed beyond copying this file into the app.

version=$("$stage" --version 2>&1); then echo 'The staged zellij command did not run; the existing command is unchanged.'; exit 1; fi; if [ "$version" != "zellij $expected" ]; then echo "The staged zellij command did not report exactly zellij $expected; the existing command is unchanged."; exit 1; fi; target="$HOME/.local/bin/$binary"; if [ -e "$target" ] || [ -L "$target" ]; then if [ !
